zayd.name: Zayd
zayd.title: Zayd
zayd.dict: The only companion of Muhammad the Quran names (33:37): by tradition Zayd ibn Haritha, his freed slave and adopted son. When Zayd divorced his wife, she was given in marriage to the Prophet, "that there may be no restriction for believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons".

zechariah.name: Zechariah
zechariah.title: Zechariah (Zakariyya)
zechariah.dict: Guardian of the young Mary in the sanctuary (3:37). Old, with a barren wife, he prays for an heir and is given John; his sign is that he cannot speak to people for three days (3:38-41, 19:2-11).
